root_cause: Input voltage sag combined with rising output ripple on one PSU in a redundant pair indicates internal capacitor degradation, typically 2-3 weeks before a hard PSU trip.
fix_action: Because PSUs are deployed N+1, the redundant unit can carry load during replacement -- confirm the partner PSU is healthy, then hot-swap the degrading unit. If this rack is in a backup window, verify the backup job's power draw profile doesn't push the single remaining PSU over its rated capacity before pulling the faulty one.
